_description: Background music. Each track under 'music' uses EITHER 'synth' (name of a built-in melody in src/game/audio/songs/, e.g. "picnic" = upbeat and cozy, "meadow" = slow and wistful) OR 'file' (path to an mp3/ogg inside public/, e.g. "assets/audio/title.mp3"). 'volume' is 0 to 1.
_usedIn: Simulation page → Start screen, Title screen, Intro slides

title._location: Starts after the first click ('Click anywhere to begin'), plays on the opening page and through the intro slides. Fades out at '6 months later' (Step 2).
